summary: Proofs are readable and adequately factored, but the private `antipodeConv`/`idConv` wrappers carry no abstraction — all ten proof steps unfold them by name — and the purely ring-theoretic sum lemma is needlessly pinned to `U`. Four single-use one-line lemmas add indirection without payoff.
